text: Build: /api/build revision equals the expected commit; verifyBuild assets plus the four guidance files are served byte-identical to the checkout and equal the commit after CRLF normalization; 78 of 81 include_str! UI text files are served byte-identical at their root path (all 81 equal the commit)

Stage 1: F1 opened guidance on a fresh France campaign; all six steps read not_yet with an obstacle and rendered explanation; procurement names the manufacturer; Your advisors opened from the same reading (route-next dropped because annual-budget already opens {"kind":"budget"}); at 390x844 the dialog, content, lesson, route panel, all six route cards, obstacles and their buttons fit without horizontal overflow; no order and the saved archive minus saved_unix is unchanged
Stage 2: 'I understand' on the budget lesson shows finances Reading: Read while Campaign: Not yet; the route is unchanged and no order was issued
Stage 2b: 'Skip for now' on the construction lesson shows construction Reading: Skipped (lesson rail: Skipped) while Campaign: Not yet; the route is unchanged and no order was issued

Stage 3: the finances obstacle was activated with focus + Enter and opened the Cabinet budget; the visible #cabinetEnact enacted it; finances is Achieved dated 1990-01-01, which equals the pre-S19 GET /api/cash-flow money.decisions row "Department funding reviewed" dated 1990-01-01

Stage 3b: the visible "Your advisors" tab showed a route-next card titled "Start a useful construction project" naming the first unachieved step (Fund a useful construction project) with its obstacle explanation; following "Explore construction" opened construction and issued no order
Stage 4a: a Starter workshop preview (can_start) was closed without confirming; the saved archive minus saved_unix, the production queue and the route are unchanged and no order was issued

Stage 4b: right after the workshop confirm (no day advanced) construction is Not yet with work_paid pending and the obstacle "Your project awaits paid work" opening project 1; pre-S19 GET /api/production shows finance.spent_bn 0 for it

Stage 4: after visible +1 DAY construction is Achieved dated by the native project last_day; pre-S19 GET /api/production shows finance.spent_bn 0.00032222222222222217 > 0 for project 1; the rendered detail reads "Paid $0.0003bn for starter industry in Île-de-France." (province name, no raw id)

Stage 5: the research obstacle opened the designer; a legal recommendation was applied and saved through the visible review; research_design is Achieved dated by the native valid draft updated_day; pre-S19 GET /api/equipment designs lists draft:S19 First Hour "S19 First Hour" with status Draft (drafts 0 -> 1)
Stage 6a: right after the airbase confirm (no day advanced) air_force is Not yet with base_funded and base_completed pending and the obstacle "Fund your airbase work"
Stage 6b: on 5 Jan 1990, after paid airbase work and before completion, air_force is In progress with base_funded Done (1990-01-04) and base_completed Not yet

Stage 6: Review airbases landed on Air command > Bases; the foundation was reviewed and confirmed; after visible +1 DAY air_force is Achieved dated by the native completed_day, base_funded is dated 1990-01-15; pre-S19 GET /api/equipment flight.bases lists FRA_le-de-france "Île-de-France airbase" with 12 aircraft spaces (status Available)
Stage 7: procurement stays Not yet with the manufacturer obstacle; following it opened Companies & Procurement; no purchase was made
